source_refs.excerpt: public static final RegistryReference<EntityType<Necromancer>> NECROMANCER_ENTITY_TYPE = REGISTRY.registerEntityType("necromancer", () -> EntityType.Builder.of(Necromancer::new, MobCategory.MONSTER).sized(0.5f, 1.92f));
context.registerEntityRenderer(ModRegistry.NECROMANCER_ENTITY_TYPE.get(), NecromancerRender::new);
context.registerLayerDefinition(ClientModRegistry.NECROMANCER_SHIELD, () -> ClientModRegistry.createIllagerBodyLayer(LayerDefinitions.INNER_ARMOR_DEFORMATION));

rows.concrete_observation: Native registered Necromancer.customServerAiStep calls parent, scans Mob bounding box inflate10 with MobType.UNDEAD predicate. Every selected update applies DAMAGE_BOOST10, MOVEMENT_SPEED10, clearFire and assigns caster current target; effect return ignored. Every10 entity tick counts send buff particles at undead and Necromancer positions. Only tickCount%20==0 sets DATA_IS_SHIELDED from list nonempty. Native hurt passes amount/2 when this stored flag true, otherwise original amount, and returns parent hurt. This is a periodically sampled spatial-presence mitigation, not protection conditional on successful buff, damage sharing or permanent immunity. No explicit owner/team association in occupancy predicate. Farther inflate30 undead additionally have current target overwritten when caster has target. Native canAttack excludes UNDEAD for Necromancer itself, not necessarily every commanded undead recipient. isPowered returns same synced shield flag; registered renderer adds NecromancerShieldLayer extending vanilla EnergySwirlLayer, layer chooses animated xOffset and armour texture.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Bind feedback to actual final policy: this shield means half incoming damage, not immune. Nearby buff particles can continue/appear independently of current sampled shield or successful status admission. Occupancy, current damage admission and per-hit reason publication are distinct; avoid using spatial companions or a shield material alone to label a hit immune. No body or art changes proposed.
